questions.q: A combined oral contraceptive prevents pregnancy primarily through which endocrine mechanism?
options: Negative feedback suppression of pituitary FSH and LH, preventing follicular maturation and the LH surge
Stimulation of a premature LH surge
questions.explain: Oestrogen and progestin provide negative feedback on the hypothalamic-pituitary axis, suppressing FSH and LH and preventing the mid-cycle LH surge and ovulation. Progestin also thickens cervical mucus and alters the endometrium.

questions.q: Which mechanism is most important for the contraceptive action of a copper intrauterine device?
options: A local inflammatory reaction that impairs sperm function and fertilisation
Complete inhibition of ovarian oestrogen production
questions.explain: Copper ions and the local sterile inflammatory response in the uterine environment impair sperm motility, viability and fertilising capacity. A copper IUD is non-hormonal and does not primarily work by suppressing ovulation.

questions.q: Which effect of progestin contributes importantly to the efficacy of many progestin-only contraceptive methods?
options: Increasing sperm transport through the cervix
questions.explain: Progestin thickens cervical mucus, making sperm penetration difficult. Depending on the method, suppression of ovulation and endometrial effects also contribute.

questions.q: Levonorgestrel emergency contraception primarily reduces pregnancy risk by which mechanism when taken before ovulation?
questions.explain: Levonorgestrel emergency contraception acts mainly by delaying or inhibiting ovulation when given before the LH surge. It does not terminate an established pregnancy.

questions.q: Which additional benefit is provided by consistent and correct use of latex condoms compared with most hormonal contraceptive methods?
options: Reduction in transmission risk of many sexually transmitted infections
Complete elimination of all STI transmission
questions.explain: Condoms provide a physical barrier that reduces the risk of many sexually transmitted infections as well as pregnancy, although protection is not complete for infections spread by uncovered skin.
